_doc: Task 6I section 8. Stage I0: overfit the same 10 canonical pairs as Task 6H H0/H0-R from a clean initialization, now through the single visual query refinement block (q0 cross-attends the frozen 64x64 SAM2 embedding once; q1 scores the 256x256 feature). The scalar objective is the frozen Task 6H.1 point-cell CE + bounded probability-mass pair loss.

block.structure: q0 -> LayerNorm -> Linear(2048,256) -> q [B,1,256]; F64 -> Conv1x1(256,256) -> flatten [B,4096,256] -> LayerNorm; CrossAttention(embed 256, 4 heads, ONE layer) -> q_ref = q + attn(q, F64); q1 = q_ref + FFN(LayerNorm(q_ref)) (256 -> 512 -> 256, GELU); heatmap = dot(q1, Conv1x1(32,256)(F256))/sqrt(256) + optional scalar bias

frozen_task6g_head.structure: query: LayerNorm(2048) -> Linear(2048,128); visual: Conv1x1(C,128); heatmap = dot(q, K)/sqrt(128) + scalar bias

budget.note: the scheduler horizon counts PAIR optimizer steps

no_gt_leakage_audit.pair_path_inputs: image + instruction + constant [BOX] + one shared frozen SAM2 feature set (64x64 embedding and 256x256 high-res level)

selection.reason: I0 is a 10-pair implementation proof; its weights are fitted to those pairs, so I1 starts from the same clean initialization convention.
